author: agent
statement: Keep the east-port-compliant compact inspection/rework cell as a physical-economy and conditional-loop improvement, without yet claiming that it repairs the leading shortage. All five current-factory scores improve by +0.438903 to +0.505000; ten transport cells, 100 build cost, and ten occupied cells are removed; mixed-quality local rework-transit WIP falls by 0.066667 equivalent units; every capacity, Objective constraint, hard outcome, delivery, quality, scrap, escape, and on-time guard passes. The quality-excursion case adds 0.045933 total WIP-equivalent but still improves score by +0.438903, and mixed-quality P95 cycle time shifts 73.856 to 78.023 s while its mean, delivery, and on-time outcome remain unchanged. Commissioning therefore requires a new immutable Run to measure the actual inspection-starvation effect and must not relabel the layout gain as causal shortage repair if that effect is absent.
